video_title: Zohran Mamdani Talks Knicks, Arsenal & What We Think of Tottenham (feat. Adam Friedland) | PTFO

quotes.speaker: Zohran Mamdani
quotes.summary_phrase: Zohran Mamdani on playing Football Manager as a team manager
quotes.excerpt: It's like playing Madden if you didn't control anything except for who played.

text_blocks.speaker: Pablo Torre
text_blocks.text: For those who don't know, this is a game where you don't actually control the players.

text_blocks.speaker: Zohran Mamdani
text_blocks.text: You're not the player. You're the manager and then you watch the players play. It's like playing Madden if you didn't control anything except for who played.

quotes.speaker: Zohran Mamdani
quotes.summary_phrase: Zohran Mamdani on signing Sebastian Frey in Football Manager
quotes.excerpt: There's a guy named Sebastian Frey who's a goalkeeper. Every year it was like a rumor.
quotes.quote: Just like the players that we would be rumored to sign every year, there's a guy named Sebastian Frey who's a goalkeeper. Every year it was like a rumor. And I was like, I'm doing it myself. I'm signing him.

quotes.speaker: Zohran Mamdani
quotes.summary_phrase: Zohran Mamdani on the importance of local connection for city leaders
quotes.excerpt: You have to live like a New Yorker to understand what New Yorkers actually need.
quotes.quote: You have to live like a New Yorker to understand what New Yorkers actually need to see from City Hall. If you just live in your tinted window vehicle, you're going to start to confuse your own needs for that of the city.

quotes.speaker: Zohran Mamdani
quotes.summary_phrase: Zohran Mamdani on the emotional impact of the Knicks' success
quotes.excerpt: The undercurrent emotion is that of joy and excitement. And you're willing to give somebody the benefit.
quotes.quote: Whether they're wearing a Knicks jersey or not, it's just let's go Knicks. It feels like the undercurrent emotion is that of joy and excitement. And you're willing to give somebody the benefit of the doubt because everybody's just praying. And it's just kept feeling like surely this is too good to be true.

quotes.speaker: Zohran Mamdani
quotes.summary_phrase: Zohran Mamdani on his Arsenal-inspired custom kurta
quotes.excerpt: I saw a photo of Ousmane Dembele from PSG. I don't know if it was real or AI.
quotes.quote: I saw a photo of Ousmane Dembele from PSG. I don't know if it was real or AI. I just was like, if these guys are doing this, he had like a full, a full faux-bon. I was like, let's make an Arsenal kurta. And there's a guy part of the Brooklyn Invincibles who designs kind of custom-made jerseys, and we hit him up and we just said, is there any way you could make a kurta?

quotes.speaker: Zohran Mamdani
quotes.summary_phrase: Zohran Mamdani on avoiding advice for other Knicks fans
quotes.excerpt: One of the things I've learned is don't give advice to other Knicks fans.
quotes.quote: One of the things I've learned is don't give advice to other Knicks fans. They will make their own decisions. I haven't given anybody advice about how to respond to me. And you know, some people are happy when they see me, some people they're not feeling the vibe. That's what it's always going to be.

quotes.speaker: Adam Friedland
quotes.summary_phrase: Adam Friedland on Arsenal's tactical evolution under Mikel Arteta
quotes.excerpt: Arsenal has figured out how to be the best at set plays. You know what a set play is?
quotes.quote: Arsenal has figured out how to be the best at set plays. You know what a set play is, Pablo? A free kick or a corner kick. Arsenal are the best at getting a guy like a 6'4 guy to do that.

quotes.speaker: Adam Friedland
quotes.summary_phrase: Adam Friedland on Mikel Arteta's leadership style
quotes.excerpt: Mikel Arteta is Joseph Stalin. It is the socialist ideal becoming fascistic.
quotes.quote: Mikel Arteta is Joseph Stalin. It is the socialist ideal becoming fascistic. And set plays are his Leningrad or Stalin-grad, sorry, or whatever.

quotes.speaker: Adam Friedland
quotes.summary_phrase: Adam Friedland on Bill Belichick's philosophy on special teams
quotes.excerpt: You know what I sound like? I sound like a guy that's like, Belichick's favorite part of the game.
quotes.quote: You know what I sound like? I sound like a guy that's like, Belichick's favorite part of the game is special teams. And if you're really, if you're watching this match, I'm watching a chess match.
